meta.title: Media skin
meta.description: Whole window, or split with separate images for the content area and the left sidebar. Each layerhas its own cropper — drag to frame it, scroll to zoom, and the preview frame is exactly what lands.No more fixed fit / position / zoom presets. Each layer also keeps its own blur, media opacity,brightness, saturation and contrast: click a media card to switch which layer the sliders edit, sothere is still only one set of sliders, and one "Copy look to ..." button pushes the whole set to theother layer in split mode. UI wash (UI opacity, sidebar tone) is shared. Media is uploaded only —no local-path input cluttering the panel. The panel is frosted glass, and the corner button is theplugin's own whale-chef avatar.
